drills.q: Name the three trust layers for evaluating a new model release.
drills.a: Lab self-report, independent aggregator (Artificial Analysis / LM Arena / METR), your own eval on your task distribution.

drills.q: What is the fastest single check to catch a misleading benchmark comparison table?
drills.a: Count how many competitor cells are unpublished ('—'). A 'win' against a blank cell isn't a measured win.

drills.q: Why is MMLU no longer a useful discriminator among frontier models?
drills.a: Saturation (scores compressed into the low-to-mid 90s) plus contamination (questions leak into pretraining data from public circulation).

drills.q: What benchmark deltas should be treated as noise rather than real signal?
drills.a: Single-run accuracy deltas under ~2-3 points, and LM Arena Elo gaps under ~10 points.

drills.q: What does LM Arena Elo measure, mechanically?
drills.a: Blind pairwise human preference votes fit to a Bradley-Terry model to produce an Elo-style score with confidence intervals -- a preference signal, not a correctness signal.

drills.q: What did arXiv 2501.17858 demonstrate about LM Arena's vulnerability to manipulation?
drills.a: A coordinated voting strategy -- fingerprinting a target model's outputs and exclusively voting for it -- can shift its ranking with as few as a few hundred rigged votes.

drills.q: What four categories make up the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1, and their weights?
What does METR's time-horizon metric measure, and how has its doubling rate changed recently?
drills.a: The length of task (in human-professional time) a model can complete autonomously at 50% reliability. Doubling period compressed from ~7 months (2019-2024) to ~4 months (2024-2025).

drills.q: What is the concrete gotcha in Llama's license that catches companies off guard?
drills.a: A 700M monthly-active-user cap measured at the parent corporate entity, frozen rather than rolling, plus an EU-specific exclusion of multimodal capabilities from the license grant.

drills.q: Which open-weight model families use MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses (fully permissive)?
drills.a: DeepSeek's V4 line (MIT); Qwen and Gemma (Apache 2.0).

drills.q: What regulatory event on 2 August 2026 changed the enforcement landscape for frontier AI documentation?
drills.a: The EU AI Act's General-Purpose AI Code of Practice obligations began enforcement -- the first external enforcement mechanism, versus labs' voluntary self-authored safety frameworks.

drills.q: Distinguish Anthropic's RSP from OpenAI's Preparedness Framework in terms of specificity.
drills.a: RSP is the most prescriptive: ASL-1 through ASL-4+ with specific precommitted weight-security tiers (RAND-based). Preparedness collapsed from four risk tiers to two qualitative bars (High/Critical), seen by analysts as weaker precommitment.

drills.q: In the Gemini 3.1 Pro '13 of 16 wins' launch (Feb 2026), what was omitted from the headline comparison table despite being in the underlying model card data?
drills.a: GDPval-AA enterprise-task Elo, where Claude models led by roughly 300 points -- present in the underlying data but absent from the headline comparison.

drills.q: Why can a benchmark ranking flip entirely between 'with tools' and 'without tools' conditions on the same benchmark (e.g. Humanity's Last Exam)?
drills.a: Tool access changes what the model can do to verify or compute an answer rather than reason it purely internally, so relative strengths (e.g. raw reasoning vs. tool-orchestration skill) can favor different models under each condition -- meaning a single headline number without the condition stated is incomplete.

drills.q: Design the four-stage process for choosing which frontier model powers a new agentic product.
drills.a: 1) Fast triage (hours): blank-cell/harness/tool-condition check, wait for one independent number. 2) Shortlist eval (days): held-out set from real production tasks, rubric tied to real outcomes, repeated runs. 3) Cost/license/ops gate: pricing at real volume, full license text, latency, availability track record. 4) Staged rollout: pinned version, small traffic percentage, continuous regression suite, widen only after real-traffic metrics confirm the offline signal.
